examples.japanese: パジャマに{着替|きが}えて{寝|ね}た。
examples.english: I changed into pajamas and went to bed.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}がパジャマのまま{外|そと}に{出|で}た。
examples.english: The child went outside still wearing pajamas.

examples.japanese: {病院|びょういん}ではパジャマで{過|す}ごすことが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: In hospitals, you often spend the day in pajamas.

notes:
パジャマ (from English "pajamas") refers to sleepwear, typically a matching top and bottom set.

Related terms:
- {寝巻|ねまき} (traditional nightwear; also includes yukata-style)
- ルームウェア (loungewear)
- {浴衣|ゆかた} (yukata - also used as sleepwear, especially at ryokan)

Common expressions:
- パジャマに{着替|きが}える (change into pajamas)
- パジャマパーティー (pajama party / sleepover)

Note: Many Japanese ryokan (traditional inns) provide yukata instead of pajamas.
